CONSTANTS.V: Set of values that may be broadcast

receivedS.description: Mapping from each process to the value it has received from the sender
receivedS.init: If sender ∈ Correct, receivedS maps all correct processes to a chosen value; otherwise unconstrained mapped to V ∪ {""}

delivered.description: Delivered value of each correct process, or empty string if undecided
delivered.init: All correct processes initially map to empty string

receivedE.description: receivedE[p][h] is the set of processes whose ECHO(h) has been received by p
receivedE.init: Initially empty for all p ∈ Correct and h ∈ Hashes

receivedR.description: receivedR[p][h] is the set of processes whose READY(h) has been received by p
receivedR.init: Initially empty for all p ∈ Correct and h ∈ Hashes

addInput.description: addInput[p] records the input to ADD for process p: either a value from V or ⊥
addInput.init: All correct processes initially map to empty string

Actions.name: StepCommit(self)
effect: If receivedS[self] ∈ V ∧ h = hash(receivedS[self]) then addInput[self] := receivedS[self]

Actions.name: FinalDeliver(self)
effect: If addInput[self] ∈ V then delivered[self] := addInput[self]
Else delivered[self] remains "" (modeling ADD(⊥) as no decision)

Actions.name: ByzantineEcho(self)
effect: ∃ d ∈ Correct, ∃ h ∈ Hashes : self ∉ receivedE[d][h] ∧ receivedE[d][h] := receivedE[d][h] ∪ {self}

Actions.name: ByzantineReady(self)
effect: ∃ d ∈ Correct, ∃ h ∈ Hashes : self ∉ receivedR[d][h] ∧ receivedR[d][h] := receivedR[d][h] ∪ {self}

Actions.name: Next
effect: (∃ self ∈ Correct : SendEcho(self) OR SendReady(self) OR StepCommit(self) OR FinalDeliver(self))
Actions.description: Global step relation: some correct process executes one of its enabled actions, or some faulty process acts.

Actions.name: Spec
effect: ∀ self ∈ Correct : WF_vars(SendEcho(self) OR SendReady(self) OR StepCommit(self) OR FinalDeliver(self))
Actions.description: Full system spec: initial condition, step relation, and weak fairness for correct-process actions.

Invariants.name: TypeInv
Invariants.description: All variables remain within their declared types

Invariants.name: Consistency
Invariants.description: No two correct processes decide different values
Invariants.spec_instance: ∀ p, q ∈ Correct : (delivered[p] ≠ "" ∧ delivered[q] ≠ "") ⇒ delivered[p] = delivered[q]

Properties.name: Totality
Properties.description: If some correct process decides, eventually all correct processes decide
Properties.spec_instance: (∃ p ∈ Correct : delivered[p] ≠ "") ~> (∀ p ∈ Correct : delivered[p] ≠ "")

Properties.name: Validity
Properties.description: If the sender is correct, all correct processes eventually decide its value
Properties.spec_instance: (sender ∈ Correct) ⇒ LET Val == IF sender ∈ Correct THEN receivedS[sender] ELSE "" IN ◇(∀ p ∈ Correct : delivered[p] = Val)

llm_hint.receivedS: receivedS[p] models the PROPOSE message received by p from the sender; single-value mapping since pseudocode has implicit echo-once guard
llm_hint.receivedE: receivedE[p][h] abstracts the set of senders whose ECHO(h) messages have been received by p
llm_hint.receivedR: receivedR[p][h] abstracts the set of senders whose READY(h) messages have been received by p
llm_hint.addInput: addInput[p] models the input to the ADD protocol after the RBC phase completes; either a valid value or ⊥
llm_hint.P_predicate: P(M) is an abstract predicate checking message validity; assumed to hold for values in V
llm_hint.hash_abstraction: hash(M) is abstracted as a deterministic mapping from V to Hashes; collision-free within V
llm_hint.Byzantine_model: Faulty processes may arbitrarily inject ECHO or READY messages for any hash to any correct process
llm_hint.no_message_queue: Explicit message queues are abstracted away in favor of set-based reception state
